questions.question: Practice Weak Forms: to and can.
questions.explanation: Practice Weak Forms: to and can.

questions.question: How is "to" usually pronounced in "I want to go"?
questions.explanation: To is weak before a verb and sounds like /tə/.

questions.question: In which sentence is "can" strong?
questions.explanation: In a short answer at the end of a sentence, can is strong: /kæn/.

questions.question: How do British speakers say "can't"?
questions.explanation: British English uses a long vowel /kɑːnt/. Americans use /kænt/.
